hero.title: Technology Made Simple
hero.text: GetDigital256 is a nonprofit in Lira that helps beginners, small businesses, teachers and young people use everyday technology and practical AI with confidence. Simple English guides, free courses and honest advice.

ask.question: Explain what an AI assistant is in simple English.
ask.answer: An AI assistant is a computer program you can chat with. You type a question and it writes an answer for you, like a helpful friend who has read a lot. Always check important answers with a trusted source.

prompt.better: Write a one page CV for a primary school teacher in Lira with three years of experience. Use simple English and bullet points.

work.label: Study plan
work.prompt: Make a four week study plan for my S4 maths exams. I can study one hour each evening.
